items.headline: US stocks: S&P 500 ends higher as investors await tech earnings
items.summary: The S&P 500 index closed higher on Tuesday, boosted by gains in Boeing and Coca-Cola.  Chip stocks experienced a significant decline as investors awaited quarterly reports from major tech firms.  Microsoft and Amazon saw movement ahead of their upcoming earnings announcements this week.  Apple's stock value surpassed five trillion dollars for the first time as it climbed.  The Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision is a key focus for markets on Wednesday.
